name: Arms of the Deep (Mythic)
body:
Your lashing strikes reach up from the water to strike from all directions.

Prerequisite(s): Large or larger size, two or more natural weapons, swim speed.

Benefit(s): While you are in the water, you gain the benefit of flanking whenever an ally threatens an enemy that is threatened by you. In addition, if you attack the same creature with two or more natural weapons, you provide the benefits of flanking to yourself against that target for each attack after the first.
